newsitem.title: UK: Further Panamax weakness undermines BFI.
newsitem.headline: Further Panamax weakness undermines BFI.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) down 19 on Wednesday to 1,392 points as the Panamax market continued to decline in the North Atlantic and North Pacific, brokers said.

Cheoyang fixed Navios Mariner for 54,000 heavy grain USGulf to Japan for May 3/15 at $22.50 or $22.65 no combination, down about 75 cents to $1 from Tuesday's rate and brokers reported tonnage willing to fix at $22.50 against charterers ideas of $22.00, no combo.

In the North Paxific the Klaveness relet Northern Venture was reported to have been fixed by Halla delivery Pacific North-West end April trip Far East at a substantially weaker $10,500 daily plus $175,000 bonus but failed on subjects even at this rate.
At 1200 gmt BIFFEX was four to 17 points lower and turnover totalled 115 lots.
